latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Video Editing with GoPro"

- Instantly edit and export GoPro action footage up to 4K by describing your edits.
- No need for manual timeline editing or export settings; just upload and type instructions.
- Fast server-side processing on cloud GPU nodes — most jobs complete within minutes.
- Supports trimming, stabilization, background music, text overlays, batching, and iterative workflows.
- 100 free usage credits available via anonymous sign-in. 
- Supports major video and audio formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, MP3, WAV, etc).
- Built-in error handling for upload, credits, and export issues.
